description.text:
Friend (朋) is one of the two booster packs of Sword & Shield: Nine Colours Gathering (九彩汇聚), alongside Origin (源). Nine Colours Gathering was the fourth Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 1 March 2024 in 5- and 25-card packs. It brought the third battle style, Fusion Strike (汇流), whose cards draw on the strength of the other Fusion Strike Pokémon in play, and the Dragon type, last seen in the Sun & Moon series, came back to the game.

Friend holds Single Strike and Rapid Strike cards but no Fusion Strike ones. It has all eight of Eevee's evolutions as Pokémon V and VMAX: Leafeon, Flareon, Vaporeon, Glaceon, Jolteon, Espeon, Sylveon and Umbreon. Its Dragon cards include Single Strike Duraludon V and VMAX, with the Stadium Crystal Cave to heal them. Its main cards are numbered out of 132; full-art, Character Super Rare, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 184.
